discoverability.population: subscribed viewers who may or may not encounter the post
eligible image post discovery only; not all post types

privacy_invariants: Only aggregate counts of public post observations; no author names, comment bodies, user IDs, replies, handles or public commenter linkage are retained
Members-only posts and subscriber-restricted surfaces are excluded absent explicit owner-authorized aggregates
Do not infer audience political affiliation, religion, ethnicity, sex, protected traits, or personal interests from comments
Counter counts are post events and do not provide unique viewers, reach, attention duration, subscriber conversion or revenue
limitations: Video commentThreads API does not independently prove it can enumerate channel Posts or YouTube Communities
Channel Posts can surface to non-subscribers; publication count is not a count of members or reached viewers
Video comment threads may omit replies and moderated/deleted submissions, even when a page is retrieved
Public likes/comments must not be divided by channel subscribers to invent an exposure-normalized engagement rate
Selected topic communities and cross-posted videos overlap, so community audience totals are not disjoint
